relevance.rationale: JOIN CONFIRMED from the arXiv title page (arXiv:1112.0030v2, hep-th): two-author, subject and identifier match the seeded entry. Citation sites: mass-theory/stokes-dt-bps-bridge.ts:22 (cites[]) and :60 (prose held in the manifest), and the sibling stokes-dt-bps-bridge.md:32 table row. LOAD-BEARING AND CORRECTLY SCOPED. The block uses this reference for exactly one thing: to name the OPEN BPS sector - conormal Lagrangian L_K inside T*S^3, colored HOMFLY homology - as the alternative to the closed / state-integral sector it then adopts. The PDF supports that attribution: the abstract states that knot homologies admit a physical description as spaces of open BPS states, and the body identifies the relevant Lagrangian as the conormal bundle to the knot (text line 189); an appendix computes the H_3 homology of the figure-eight knot, matching the reference entry's note. Crucially the block does NOT attribute det(4_1) = 5 to this paper - it sources that count from the knots-quivers correspondence [kucharski-reineke-stosic-sulkowski2017] and uses this reference only for the sector identification, so its negative conclusion (the open-HOMFLY bridge does not reproduce the resurgent Stokes spectrum {3,4}) is a correctly-sourced scope-(a) statement about the sector.

keyResults.statement: Reduced/colored HOMFLY homology of a knot K is the space of OPEN BPS states of an M5-brane on the conormal Lagrangian L_K in T*S^3; colored differentials relate homologies at different representations.
keyResults.useForFolio: The literature basis for the 'open' row of the stokes-dt-bps-bridge non-degeneracy table, i.e. for the claim that two inequivalent knot-homology/BPS bridges exist and only the closed one reproduces {3,4}.

keyResults.statement: Explicit computation of the S^3- and Lambda^3-colored (H_3) homology of the figure-eight knot.
keyResults.useForFolio: The only 4_1-specific count in the paper; the natural place to check any future claim about GS-side 4_1 numbers rather than importing det(4_1)=5 from the quiver paper.

proposedActions.rationale: The citation is load-bearing, correctly scoped, and the block already distinguishes what GS supplies from what the quiver paper supplies. Nothing to change.
